n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

MAX_SIZE = 505
C = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(MAX_SIZE)]
way = [0] * MAX_SIZE
sum_arr = [0] * MAX_SIZE
g = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(MAX_SIZE)]
f = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(MAX_SIZE)]

def add_mod(a, b):
    res = a + b
    if res >= mod:
        res -= mod
    return res

def multiply_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % mod

def triangle_sum(i):
    return i * (i + 1) // 2

# Compute binomial coefficients
for i in range(m + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = add_mod(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j])

# Compute way and sum arrays
way[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        way[i] = add_mod(way[i], multiply_mod(multiply(i + 1, C[i - 1][j]), multiply_mod(way[j], way[i - j - 1])))
        sum_arr[i] = add_mod(sum_arr[i], multiply_mod(multiply(triangle_sum(j), way[j]), way[i - j - 1]))
        sum_arr[i] = add_mod(sum_arr[i], multiply_mod(multiply(i + 1, add_mod(multiply(sum_arr[j], way[i - j - 1]), multiply(way[j], sum_arr[i - j - 1]))), C[i - 1][j]))

n += 1
f[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(m - j + 1):
            if i + k + 1 <= n:
                val_f = multiply_mod(f[i][j], way[k])
                f[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(f[i + k + 1][j + k], val_f)
                val_g = add_mod(multiply_mod(val_f, sum_arr[k]), multiply_mod(g[i][j], way[k]))
                g[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(g[i + k + 1][j + k], val_g)

print(g[n][m])
